component.name: nlink-lab
component.summary: Design, run and change nlink-lab network labs

description.p: The desktop app of nlink-lab. It draws a topology from its NLL file (namespaces, containers, links, bridges, tunnels, sites) and edits it, with its problems where they are; it deploys and applies it through the nlink-lab daemon, with the plan or the changes first and the progress as it goes.

A running lab shows its traffic live on the drawing. Impair or cut a link, restore a snapshot, start and stop processes, run a command, follow a log, capture packets into a pcap file, open a shell on a node, and run the lab's scenarios, benchmarks and assertions.
